A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Can you help with a parcel within India?+

Yes, tell our team where you’re sending from and where the parcel needs to go. We’ll confirm the available option for your exact route before you book.

Can you provide a domestic price online?+

Prices depend on the route, parcel size and weight. Share those details in the quote form or call us for help.

Do the office cities represent the delivery area?+

No. Mumbai, Kochi, Delhi and Bengaluru are listed office locations. Delivery availability needs a separate check for your exact route.
